description: This file provides utility functions for file system operations such as writing a file if changed, removing a file, and removing a directory or path if it exists.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes the specified contents to a file if the current file content differs, creating directories as needed. Returns true if the file was written, false if unchanged.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Removes the specified file if it exists. Returns true if the file was removed, false otherwise.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory or path recursively if it exists. Returns true if successful, false otherwise.
